limits: Prepared author probe, no automatic declaration that CUA cases passed.
Only actual native keys/menu/focus events can establish the requested input observations; no host input injection exists here.
TS maps independent physical Shift keys to Select OR; host does not know NES mapping.

At most32 input FIFO fronts are individually applied/ACKed before each batch of at most4 core frames. The batch shares one cached complete key set; new input waits until the next poll, not zero latency. Repeated receipts never repeat business apply.
Window-ready and subscribed window facts diagnose native association; they do not prove CUA binding or visible pixels.
Explicit withhold-input-ack marker stalls ACK/core and can trigger host timeout; that is recorded as sourceError/failure, never a pass.
Between-frame freeze may discard bounded<=4096 pre-generated PCM; no exact consumed-frame checkpoint/zero-drop promise.
No screen pixel/physical GUI/voice/10minute/save/reset/newROM acceptance inferred from this script.
